about: Pages that are opened from outside the navigation by design, so the three-selections measure leaves them out of its count. They are still listed in every report. Add a route only with its reason.

routes./share/courses/[courseId]: Opened from a share link someone sends; the course itself is in the catalog.
routes./share/courses/[courseId]/[lessonId]: Opened from a share link someone sends; the lesson is reached through its course.
routes./share/equity-toolkit: Opened from a share link someone sends.
routes./share/equity-toolkit/practice: Opened from a share link someone sends.
routes./share/library/[id]: Opened from a share link someone sends; the item is in the library.
routes./embedded-tools/ask: Embedded in other DHS sites, not a page in this site's navigation.
routes./embedded-tools/search: Embedded in other DHS sites, not a page in this site's navigation.
